description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.name: Scorned Villager // Moonscarred Werewolf
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Moonscarred Werewolf and without summoning sickness
